brief: Apple's new Macs boost local AI, while OpenAI restores limits; geopolitics sees Trump's Canada trade war and Ukraine missile pleas; research focuses on AI disclosure and visualization.
news_summary: Apple's Mac Studio and Mac mini target local AI inference, while OpenAI reimposes usage limits. Elsewhere, Trump's trade war with Canada and UK PM Burnham's Ukraine diplomacy dominate headlines.
papers_summary: Research covers AI disclosure expectations, PFAS immunotoxicity, and visualization systems for urban safety and older adults, among other topics.
